column2: Ticket 05: `r` on `main`'s row with `feature` checked out, five commits, the third editing the file `main` edited. The box's forecast row reads `may stop at step 3 of 5 (pick <sha7>) · not checked past it`: at 80 columns the path and the subject are cut, the step and the commit never; `feature` is named whole in the title and its ref row. Colour unverified (rule 5).

Ticket 05b: `r` on `main`'s row with `feature-a` checked out, `feature-b` built on it and `feature-c` on that. The box reads `4 commits replayed`, then a `branches:` label with three rows bottom first — feature-a, feature-b, feature-c — the two above his ending `built on yours · follows`; the command line ends `main feature-c` (the top). Above, four ghost rows (a1 a2 b1 c1) on `main`, each branch badge on its own ghost. Colour unverified (rule 5).

Tickets 05b + rebase-preview-keeps-drops: `r` on `main`'s row; `feature-a` was squash-merged into main as "Add OAuth (#42)" and `feature-b` is built on it. The box reads `1 commit replayed`, `feature-a <sha7> → <main's sha7>`, feature-b `→ 1 new commit · built on yours · follows`, then `already in main: feature-a's 3 commits match <sha7> "Add OAuth (#42)" · dropped · R to keep them`; the footer reads `y confirm  r rebase  R keep  ←→ choose  ⏎ act  esc cancel`. One ghost only, b1: no ghost for a dropped commit. Colour unverified (rule 5).

Ticket rebase-preview-keeps-drops: after `R`, before `p`. Each suggested row shows the drop action and `already in main · p keeps it`; no row says `marked by its name`; the last row is `─ main` at the squash commit; the cursor `▸` on the newest drop, a3. Unedited, every row is dropped, so AFTER reads `every commit dropped` and the bar has no `y rewrite` until `p`. Colour unverified (rule 5).

Ticket 05b: `r` on `main`'s row with `feature-a` checked out and two branches both built on it (a fork). No box: the graph as it was, every ref where it was, and the status line reads `feature-b and feature-c are both built on yours · Graft moves one line · esc dismiss`. Colour unverified (rule 5).

Ticket 10b: `. ⏎` on `feature-b`'s row with the tree clean — no preview box, no `y`. The cursor is on the new HEAD's row (`feature-b`, drawn `◆`) and the status line reads `on feature-b ✓ · u goes back`. Colour unverified (rule 5).

Ticket 10b: `b feature-c ⇥ ⏎` on HEAD's own row (`main`) over a staged and an unstaged edit — the prompt closes and a `Preview: branch feature-c at <sha7>` box opens (no refusal). Its rows: `feature-c (new) → <sha7>`, `HEAD → feature-c`, `your edits stay as they are` (nothing is set aside at HEAD), and `y confirm` on the box's bottom edge. Colour unverified (rule 5).

Ticket 09: `j a` on "Add OAuth callback" (one row below HEAD on `feature-a`) with a fix to `src/auth.rs` staged and `feature-b` built on `feature-a`. The box is titled `Preview: put your staged changes into <sha7> "Add OAuth callback"`; its first row reads `<sha7>  Add OAuth callback  gains  src/auth.rs +1 −1`; the branches rows end with feature-b `→ 3 new commits · built on yours · follows`; the footer reads `y put it in`. `src/tokens.rs` is also edited, not staged: the box says one thing about his edits — `your edits: 1 file set aside, put back after` (the unstaged `src/tokens.rs`; the staged fix goes into the commit, review Minor 6), then `no conflicts expected` — and never `nothing is put back` (09b). The undo line reads `undo: u takes this back`, every preview's line (09b ruling). Colour unverified (rule 5).

Ticket 09b: `k .` on the uncommitted row with three hunks staged. The cursor is on `Put staged changes into their commits (absorb)`, the first item; below it, in their old order, `Open details (⏎)`, `Fetch (f)`, `Pull (p)`, `Push (P)`, `Undo (u)`. Colour unverified (rule 5).

Ticket 09 (09b: the menu opens on absorb): `k . ⏎` over three staged hunks, nothing unstaged: no `your edits:` row (the staged hunks go into commits or stay staged; nothing of his is set aside and put back, review Minor 6); `no conflicts expected`, no `nothing is put back`; `undo: u takes this back`. The box is titled `Preview: put staged changes into the commits they belong to`; rows `src/auth.rs    line 5  → <sha7>  Add OAuth callback`, `src/tokens.rs  line 5  → <sha7>  Handle expired tokens`, `README         line 2  stays staged · no commit on your branch changed these lines`, columns aligned; the footer reads `y put them in`. Colour unverified (rule 5).

Ticket 09: after `y` on the put-in. The cursor is on the new HEAD ("Handle expired tokens", checked by the walk, not visible in text); `✎ changed` sits two cells after "Add OAuth callback" and on no other row; the uncommitted row reads `(1 unstaged)`; the status reads `put into "Add OAuth callback" ✓ · your unstaged edits are back · u undoes` (09b). The rewritten commits read `2d` like the rest, never `futu…`: the capture runs with git's clock pinned before `CORPUS_NOW` (review Minor 7), so their SHAs are the same every run and nothing is masked. Colour unverified (rule 5).

Ticket 03b: `p` on the graph on `main`, origin one ahead changing line 1 of `shared.txt`, his unsaved edit to line 10. HEAD at origin's tip; `shared.txt` holds both changes, his diff lines byte-equal and still unstaged; no stash left; the cursor (`▏`) on the new HEAD's row; the line `pulled origin/main ✓ · your edits are back`. Colour unverified.

Ticket 13b: a real submodule at `libs/parser`, pointer moved and a file changed inside, 187 columns: the row reads `▣ libs/parser  submodule · pointer moved <old7> → <new7> · changed inside` in full. Colour unverified.

Ticket 16b: `P` after a rejected push, teammate's commits on origin. Lease box: line 1 (`origin/main <theirs> → <ours> · refused if …`), then `rewrites history for everyone who has <sha7>`, then `leaves origin/main:`, then one row per commit — sha7, subject, author, aligned in columns, subject cut with `…` — newest first, at most 3, then `+N more`; buttons row whole. Colour unverified.

Ticket 16b: the same lease box at 80x24: `leaves origin/main:`, one row per commit — sha7, subject, author, aligned in columns, subject cut with `…` — newest first, at most 3, then `+N more`; buttons row whole. Colour unverified.

Ticket 21b: blame of `src/auth/session.rs`, cursor in `refresh_token`, `L`. Row 1 begins `HISTORY · src/auth/session.rs · fn refresh_token`; the version list on the left, `▸` on a row, `the file starts here` last; the file pane on the right with `┃` down the traced lines; the bottom row is `j/k older·newer  tab file  n/N next change  B blame here  ⏎ that commit  esc back`. No graph behind it. Colour unverified.

Ticket 21b: `F` on the file, whole-file history. Row 1 `HISTORY · src/auth/session.rs · 6 changes`; a `was src/session.rs` row; no `┃`; the bottom row the same list bar as the line history. Colour unverified.
Ticket 21b: the history place at 100x30: list only, no file pane; the bottom row whole, no word cut, `⇥ file` in it. Colour unverified.

Ticket 21b: (a) `⏎` on a version, then `Tab` to the graph — the graph's bar begins `esc back to history`, never `back to blame`; (b) one `esc` — the history place again, same commit `▸`. Colour unverified.
Ticket 07c: a chain rewrite stopped on a conflict. Row 1 `REBASING  step 3 of 5 · pick <sha7> b1 · feature-b, branch 2 of 3`; the resolver below on `shared.txt`. Colour unverified.

Ticket 07d: an `edit` stop on his a3 of 5, Sara's feature-b above. `still to apply · not commits yet` boxed; his two `pick` rows only (a5, a4); `feature-b (Sara): 2 commits follow, on top`; `▏` on `[HEAD] a3  HEAD · stopped here`; bar contains `a amend it`, `c continue`, `space stage`. Colour unverified.

Ticket 07b/07c/07d: the `edit` stop at 120x40: banner without the edit hint; the box with `pick a2`, then feature-b and feature-c follower rows (reads `1 commit follow`: grammar defect, open); `▏` on the stopped commit; bar `⇥ banner  a amend it  c continue`, `space` bare at this width. Colour unverified.

Ticket 07d: the `edit` stop at 80x24, his 10 rows + Sara's 2, stopped on his a3: `REBASING  step 3 of 12` whole; no `change files` hint; six `pick` rows then `+1 more` (7 pending); the row `feature-b (Sara): 2 commits follow, on top` drawn. Colour unverified.

Ticket 08: `R` on `feature-a`'s HEAD row, then `s s`. Title `REWRITE feature-a · 5 commits since it left main · newest first · nothing written until y`. Rows newest first: two `squash ↓` rows (wip, wip: tests) over `▸ pick <sha7> Handle expired tokens`, the `fixup ↓` row `marked by its name`, `pick Add OAuth callback`, then `─ main <sha7> m1 stays`. A `│` rule at column 96; right of it `AFTER y · not written yet`: feature-b `○ new b1 built on yours · follows`, feature-a `● new Handle expired tokens 3 in one`, `○ new Add OAuth callback fixup melded in`, main `unchanged`; then `built on yours: feature-b (Graft Fixture, 1 commit) follows`, `no conflicts expected`. Under the rows `MESSAGE of the squashed commit · r on "Handle expired tokens" changes it` and the `┊` gutter: the kept row's message first, then the melded ones newest first (wip, then wip: tests with its body). Bar starts `y rewrite`. Colour unverified (rule 5).

Ticket 08: the same editor at 140x40 (120–179): no `│` rule; the rows, then a blank line and `AFTER y · not written yet` with the same AFTER rows and facts under them, then the MESSAGE block below AFTER. Bar as at 187. Colour unverified (rule 5).

Ticket 08: the same editor at 100x30 (below 120): rows only, no AFTER on screen; the MESSAGE block under the rows; the bar reads `y rewrite  tab after  ⏎ changes …` (`Tab` swaps to AFTER). Colour unverified (rule 5).

Ticket 08: `R` on HEAD (`feature-a`) with `feature-b` and `feature-c` both built on it. No editor: the graph as it was, and the status line reads `feature-b and feature-c are both built on yours · Graft moves one line · esc dismiss`. Colour unverified (rule 5).

Ticket 11: `o` on login-page's `fix the bug`, main checked out, base.txt edited. Title `Preview: take <sha7> "fix the bug" onto main`; bar `y confirm  ←→ choose  ⏎ act  esc cancel`; `your edits: 1 file set aside, put back after`. Colour unverified.
Ticket 11: `o` on a merge commit. No preview box; the status line `<sha7> is a merge · taking a merge isn't in Graft yet`. Colour unverified.
Ticket 11: `.` on HEAD's row (main). Slot 1 `Checkout — already on main`, slot 2 `Cherry-pick (o) — already on main`, both dim, in places 1 and 2. Dim is colour: unverified.
